children: Samsung Wallet adds support for USDC on Sui in November 2026. The integration was first announced at Sui Basecamp and is available to eligible Galaxy users in the United States.
The integration brings Sui stablecoin use to a large consumer wallet. USDC on Sui becomes part of Samsung Wallet's supported assets, giving users access through the wallet on their Galaxy devices.
Cards, keys, boarding passes. Already in Samsung Wallet. ✅
on Sui is coming to Samsung Wallet for eligible U.S. Galaxy users later this month.
